verdict.rationale: Greptile exposes a real, auth-gated public API (api.greptile.com/v2/repositories confirmed live via runtime probe) plus a scriptable CLI and MCP server that let an AI-native user drive reviews programmatically, and docs are also mirrored as agent-readable markdown/llms.txt. However, no formal API reference or OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found (all candidate openapi.json/swagger.json paths 404), so the public API's documentation is thin compared to the CLI/MCP docs. Missing for 10: a comprehensive REST API reference or OpenAPI schema, and independent hands-on confirmation of API usage beyond the keyless auth-gate probe.
